prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

(none yet)

- sign_in: 74.1%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_flow] Guided Photo Customization Assistance Flow: Rebuilds photo uploading into an assisted flow with instant quality feedback and template guidance for custom pet generation. (why: Three support tickets reported custom pet creation failures or distorted render outputs during adoption.)
1: [home, redesign] Desktop Pet Environment Incubator Waiting Screen: Redesigns the waiting screen into a pet habitat incubator stage with active rendering progress indicators. (why: The waiting step has high median and mean durations (201s / 2336s), leading to user dropoff before reaching home intro.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Account Pet Data Protection Hint: Adds an explanatory hint explaining that signing in syncs pet ownership across devices and prevents pet resets. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing back into their account.)
3: [choose_path, layout] Two-Column Path Choice Layout: Changes the path selection layout to a balanced two-column comparison. (why: 23.8% of users drop off at choose_path despite taking only 8 seconds median, suggesting decision fatigue.)
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop Launch Stage Progress Display: Displays estimated render time and live asset creation status during background setup. (why: Support received tickets about pets failing to show or app stalling during desktop initialization.)
5: [finish, hint] Desktop Pet Interaction Shortcuts Hint: Displays a clear usage hint on the home welcome screen detailing key tray commands. (why: Users reported confusion regarding how to summon, minimize, or hide pets post-setup.)
6: [adoption, incentive] Official Adoption Stamp Bonus Badge: Adds a decorative verified adoption badge component to the certificate screen to increase completion motivation. (why: Adoption completion rate drops significantly to 60.9%, making it the largest bottleneck in onboarding.)
7: [sign_in, copy] Direct Login Quick Connect Headline: Updates sign-in headline and button copy to emphasize instant secure authentication. (why: Sign-in dropoff stands at 25.9%, and 2 support tickets reported sign-in stalling or screen issues.)
